Here’s a classic ingredient list for a traditional meat‑based lasagna:

**For the Béchamel Sauce (White Sauce)**
- Unsalted butter – 2 Tbsp (about 30 g)
- All‑purpose flour – 2 Tbsp (about 15 g)
- Whole milk – 2 cups (480 ml), warmed
- Pinch of nutmeg – optional
- Salt & pepper – to taste

**For the Meat Ragù (Meat Sauce)**
- Olive oil – 1 Tbsp
- Onion, finely chopped – 1 medium (≈150 g)
- Carrot, finely diced – 1 small (≈50 g)
- Celery stalk, finely diced – 1 small (≈50 g)
- Garlic cloves, minced – 2–3
- Ground beef or a mix of ground beef & pork – 1 lb (450 g)
- Tomato paste – 2 Tbsp (≈30 g)
- Crushed tomatoes or passata – 1 cup (240 ml)
- Red wine (optional) – ½ cup (120 ml)
- Bay leaf – 1
- Dried oregano – ½ tsp
- Salt & pepper – to taste

**Other Components**
- Lasagna sheets – 9–12 sheets (no‑boil or regular, depending on preference)
- Shredded mozzarella cheese – 2 cups (≈200 g)
- Grated Parmesan cheese – ½ cup (≈50 g)
- Fresh basil leaves – a handful (optional, for garnish)

**Optional Add‑ons**
- Ricotta cheese – 1 cup (≈250 g) mixed with an egg and parsley for extra richness
- Spinach or other leafy greens – sautéed and drained if you want a veggie layer

That’s it! Mix the béchamel and ragù together, layer with pasta sheets, cheeses, and bake until bubbly and golden. Enjoy your lasagna!
